spans.s:
लड् r. 1st and 10th cls. (लडति लडयति)
 1. To frolic, to sport or dally.
2. To loll, (the tongue.)
 3. To use the tongue.
 4. To stir with the
tongue.
 5. To stir, to agitate.
 6. To pain. r. 10th cl. (लाडयति-ते)
 1.
To nurse, to foster, to attend closely.
 2. To shake.
 3. To feel de-
sire.
 4. To spread. (औ, इ) औलडि r. 1st and 10th cls. (लण्डति लण्ड-
यति-ते)
 1. To shine.
 2. The toss or throw up.
 3. To speak.

लाड् r. 10th cl. (लाडयति-ते)
 1. To throw, to toss.
 2. To fondle, to caress.
 3. To blame.
लडह mfn. (-हः-हा-हं) Beautiful, pleasing, charming, (used in Prākrita.)
लड्ड m. (-ड्डः) A wretch, a villain, a low or bad man.

लड्डुक n. (-कं) A class of sweetmeats, or a sweetmeat, a sort of ball
made with flour fried with oil or ghee, and mixed with sugar and
spices, and distinguished into different kinds, according to some
slight varieties in its less essential ingredients; also read लड्डक.
